# Texas Instruments TMS7000

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs` from `crates/isa/src/tms7000.rs`. Edits here are overwritten; change the spec instead. -->

63 mnemonics, 203 encoded forms, operands big-endian. Generated from [`crates/isa/src/tms7000.rs`](https://github.com/asm198x/asm198x/blob/main/crates/isa/src/tms7000.rs).

Cycle counts show the base cost; `+p` is an extra cycle when an
indexed access crosses a page boundary, `+t` when a branch is taken.
